summary: Beta Bionics, Inc. filed a preliminary prospectus supplement under Rule 424(b)(5) for a $125 million underwritten offering of common stock, listed on Nasdaq under BBNX. The last reported sale price was $16.73 per share on September 14, 2026, with pricing to be negotiated with the lead underwriters; J.P. Morgan, Piper Sandler, Wells Fargo Securities and Leerink Partners were named. Underwriters received a 30-day option for up to an additional $18,750,000 of shares. Use of proceeds and dilution sections are referenced. This is a routine follow-on shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch pricing terms versus market.
